text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the trainer's office, Smart Falcon 
spoke to me while holding her forehead for 
some reason...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Um, hey... Trainer. Can you tell 
Falco that I'm cute...?
choice_data_list: What's with you all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco got a headache. I tried resting and 
taking medicine, but..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's not getting any better at all, so 
here's my last resort! I want to try 
'Cutie Therapy'...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like chanting 'pain, pain, go away,' 
if someone would just tell me I'm 'cute'—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The happiness will surely cure my 
headache! So please... Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay☆ Now Falco's headache will...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although I managed to soothe Smart 
Falcon... her headache stubbornly refused 
to go away.
